notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello friends! This week there were 2 updates that I fixed/added/broke😅:

[list]
[*] Improved the camera zoom-out algorithm. Now when enemies are below the hero, the camera zooms out earlier, giving a greater view and reaction time.
[*] Improved the target detection algorithm.
[*] Enemies are highlighted when they are behind horizontal walls.
[*] Fixed a shader bug with video textures.
[*] Improved the balance of some enemy attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug with some wall textures.
[*] Ghosts appear only within the room.
[*] Hero weapon balancing.
[*] Enemy weapon balancing.
[*] Changing the mummy with a laser beam (level 3).
[*] Fixed bugs with shader display on some devices.
[*] Fixed a bug with crashing out of the game.
[/list]
